decision.importNetTarget.en: Import at a net target price

decision.importNetTargetBody.es: La ruta de importar y vender utiliza un precio objetivo que ya incorpora las tasas configuradas. No podemos separar fielmente esos cargos de su resultado neto. Si se combina con otras rutas, el subtotal visible de impuestos cubre solo las otras ventas.
decision.importNetTargetBody.en: The import-and-sell route uses a target price already accounting for configured fees. Its charges cannot be truthfully itemized from the net amount. In mixed plans, the visible tax subtotal covers the other sales only.

decision.includedInNet.es: Estos cargos ya están descontados del resultado neto; no se restan de nuevo.
decision.includedInNet.en: These costs are already deducted from the net result; they are not subtracted again.

decision.costsWhy.en: Where do these deductions come from?

decision.accountingConfigured.es: El Sales Tax configurado es {rate} %. EVE parte de 7,5 % y Accounting reduce ese impuesto un 11 % relativo por nivel; coincide con nivel {level} en Ajustes. Se cobra al completarse la venta. Una coincidencia no significa que tu personaje esté verificado.
decision.accountingConfigured.en: The configured sales tax is {rate}%. EVE starts at 7.5%, reduced by 11% of that base per Accounting level; it matches level {level} in Settings. Tax is charged on sale. A matching rate does not verify your pilot.

decision.accountingCustom.es: Se usa el Sales Tax de {rate} % indicado en Ajustes. Puede ser una tarifa introducida manualmente: no se atribuye a una habilidad sin confirmación.
decision.accountingCustom.en: The {rate}% sales tax entered in Settings is used. It may be a manually entered rate; we cannot attribute it to a skill without confirmation.

decision.brokerJita.es: Publicación de orden en Jita · Broker

decision.brokerJitaBody.es: La comisión configurada para una orden en Jita es {rate} %. En estaciones NPC parte del 3 %: Broker Relations reduce 0,3 puntos porcentuales por nivel y los standings sin modificar pueden reducirla más. Se cobra al publicar la orden, no en una venta inmediata. Comprueba la tarifa real en EVE.
decision.brokerJitaBody.en: The configured fee for placing a Jita order is {rate}%. At NPC stations it starts at 3%: Broker Relations lowers it by 0.3 percentage points per level, with possible additional unmodified-standings reductions. It is charged when placing an order, not on an immediate sale. Check the actual EVE fee.

decision.brokerStructureBody.es: En {market} se usan las tasas configuradas: comisión de estructura {broker} % y SCC {scc} %. Broker Relations no reduce automáticamente la tarifa del propietario de una estructura Upwell.
decision.brokerStructureBody.en: At {market}, the configured rates are: structure broker fee {broker}% and SCC {scc}%. Broker Relations does not automatically reduce an Upwell structure owner's fee.

decision.relistingBody.es: Tienes activada la provisión de cambios de precio. El plan reserva {amount} según la cantidad de relists y Advanced Broker Relations configurados.
decision.relistingBody.en: Your price-change allowance is enabled. The plan reserves {amount} based on the configured relist count and Advanced Broker Relations.

decision.marketNone.en: This route does not use a taxed EVE market sale. A buyback may apply its own contract discount, which is not sales tax.

decision.shippingBody.en: Estimated shipping is {amount} for {contracts} contracts and {volume}: base fee {base} per contract + {unit} per m³ + {collateral}% of collateral. The cost is shared among items on the same shipment.

decision.shippingNone.en: Estimated courier charges are 0 ISK. The chosen route may stay local, or delivery pricing may be switched off. Self-hauling may have other costs.

decision.refiningBody.en: For a reprocessing route, the engine deducts {amount} as the configured refinery's estimated fee ({rate}%). EVE's valuation basis may differ from the estimate.

decision.refineComparison.en: Keeping other items on their selected routes, {best} leaves more ISK. Reprocessed: {reprocessed}; raw: {raw}; difference in favor of reprocessing: {delta}.

decision.refineMethod.es: Se comparan alternativas de este item con las tasas de mercado, tarifa estimada de refinería y el cambio real en un único courier compartido (incluidos saltos de contrato). Los demás items mantienen su ruta. Son estimaciones, no garantías; un plan manual no se modifica automáticamente.
decision.refineMethod.en: Alternatives for this item account for market charges, estimated refinery fee and the real change to one shared courier bill (including contract thresholds). Other items keep their routes. These are estimates, not guarantees; manually selected plans are not changed automatically.

decision.priceSourceQ.es: ¿De dónde vienen los precios de cada item?
decision.priceSourceQ.en: Where do each item's prices come from?

decision.priceSourceA.es: Market Moves+ utiliza cotizaciones disponibles de Jita mediante ESI y los precios que introduces manualmente. Las tarifas configuradas afectan las estimaciones netas, no los precios del mercado. Las cotizaciones pueden desactualizarse y el volumen mostrado no garantiza compradores para todo el lote. Si falta un precio, se muestra una advertencia sin asumir una venta.
decision.priceSourceA.en: Market Moves+ uses available Jita quotes through ESI and the prices you enter manually. Configured fees affect estimated net proceeds, not market prices. Quotes may become stale, and displayed volume does not guarantee buyers for an entire lot. Missing prices are flagged without assuming a sale.

decision.planMethodQ.es: ¿Por qué este plan y no el más rápido?
decision.planMethodQ.en: Why this plan instead of the fastest one?

decision.planMethodA.es: Comparamos ingresos netos después de las comisiones y un único envío compartido. Las opciones rápidas pueden sacrificar ISK: una orden tarda en completarse y la venta inmediata depende de compras reales suficientes. En Trading hablamos de ganancia solo si hay un coste de compra válido.
decision.planMethodA.en: We compare net proceeds after fees and one shared shipment. Faster options may sacrifice ISK: sell orders take time and instant sales need sufficient real buy orders. In Trading, we show profit only with a valid purchase cost.

decision.collateralQ.es: ¿El colateral es otro coste de envío?

decision.collateralA.es: No. En un contrato courier, el colateral es una garantía que se devuelve al completar el trabajo; no se resta entero como tarifa. El transportista puede calcular su precio usando el colateral y el volumen transportados. Market Moves+ descuenta del resultado la tarifa de envío estimada, no el colateral.
decision.collateralA.en: No. In a courier contract, collateral is security returned when the job is completed; the full collateral is not deducted as a fee. The carrier may base its fee on collateral and cargo volume. Market Moves+ deducts the estimated freight fee from proceeds, not the collateral.

mining.grossWarning.es: Los ISK/h mostrados no siempre descuentan impuestos, refinería o transporte: son estimaciones de producción, no necesariamente ganancia final.
mining.grossWarning.en: ISK/h may not include selling tax, reprocessing fees or shipping: it estimates production value, not necessarily final profit.

refinery.profileNote.en: Estimated yield based on skills, structure, rig and implant

trade.buyOrderUnitOverride.es: Mi precio Buy Order por unidad (opcional)
trade.buyOrderUnitOverride.en: My Buy Order price per unit (optional)

trade.buyOrderBasis.es: La inversión usa la mejor Buy Order publicada en Jita o tu precio manual; incluye broker. La orden puede tardar en completarse.
trade.buyOrderBasis.en: Investment uses the top posted Jita Buy Order or your manual price, including broker. Your order may take time to fill.

trade.buyOrderIntro.es: Presupuestas una Buy Order en Jita, transportas con SIGMA Freight y proyectas vender en {market} a Jita Sell +{margin}% neto.
trade.buyOrderIntro.en: Budget a Jita Buy Order, ship with SIGMA Freight and target sales in {market} at Jita Sell +{margin}% net.

trade.sellIntro.es: Compras a Jita Sell, transportas con SIGMA Freight y proyectas vender en {market} a Jita Sell +{margin}% neto.
trade.sellIntro.en: Buy at Jita Sell, ship with SIGMA Freight and target sales in {market} at Jita Sell +{margin}% net.

trade.buyBasisDetail.es: Compra: {quantity} × {unit} + broker {broker}% (precio de referencia, no compra garantizada).
trade.buyBasisDetail.en: Purchase: {quantity} × {unit} + {broker}% broker (reference price, not a guaranteed fill).

trade.sellBasisDetail.es: Compra: {quantity} × {unit} a Jita Sell, sujeta a profundidad de órdenes.
trade.sellBasisDetail.en: Purchase: {quantity} × {unit} at Jita Sell, subject to order-book depth.

trade.purchaseUnavailable.es: Beneficio no calculable: falta un precio de compra válido en Jita. Actualiza precios o abre el item del Listado para introducir tu precio Buy Order por unidad. No se utilizarán precios filtrados de venta como coste de compra.
trade.purchaseUnavailable.en: Profit unavailable: no valid Jita purchase quote. Refresh market prices or open the item in Registered Items to enter your Buy Order unit price. Filtered sell-to-bid prices cannot be used as a purchase budget.

trade.purchaseUnavailableShort.es: Falta un precio de compra confiable; todavía no se puede estimar tu beneficio.
trade.purchaseUnavailableShort.en: No reliable purchase quote is available yet; your profit cannot be estimated.

trade.tradeSubtitle.es: BENEFICIO TRAS COMPRA, IMPUESTOS Y ENVÍO
trade.tradeSubtitle.en: PROFIT AFTER PURCHASE, TAXES AND SHIPPING

trade.proceedsOnly.es: Los importes de los planes son ingresos netos de venta; falta el capital de compra para calcular beneficio.
trade.proceedsOnly.en: Plan amounts are net selling proceeds; a purchase quote is needed to calculate profit.
